craft_notes: Sthāyin: moonlight-ask (twice-born mind's going). Rows: row 2 (moonlight→supreme). Close: supreme (pare as landing: the asked height). Rejected: 'enlighten me' — killed: heaven-going kept (gati as motion, not light); 'lotus' prettified — kept night-lotus-opening (kumuda specificity kept).

lines: Ever-risen, blessed, all-blissful, Śiva-giving, heart-homed in Śiva, O Śivā —
night-lotus-opening moonlight: to the worshipping mind, make my heaven-going supreme.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sadodite bhagavati sarvamaṅgale | śivaprade śivahṛdayasthite śive | bhajanmanaḥ kumudavikāsacandrike | dvijanmanaḥ kuru mama khe gatiṃ pare

reads_against.argmap: What is asked at moonrise? → Moonlight-prayer for the twice-born mind: opened like night-lotus, made to go supreme in heaven.
c1_essence: Moonlight-prayer for the twice-born mind: night-lotus-opened, made to go supreme in heaven.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta with bhakti (wonder held in devotion)
